rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the drug cocaine.

example.english: They ended up in hospital after taking coke.
example.traditional: 佢因為吸可卡因入咗院。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 wai6 kap1 ho2 kaa1 jan1 jap6 zo2 jyun2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the solid coal residue used as industrial fuel or in steelmaking.

example.english: This steel mill uses a lot of coke every day.
example.traditional: 呢間鋼廠每日都要用好多焦炭。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gong1 cong2 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jung6 hou2 do1 ziu1 taan3
